title: Hobby Lobby Recalls Infant Pacifier Holders Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The fin of the whale and the head of the octopus can detach from the pacifier holder, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 12,900.

title: Hobby Lobby Recalls Infant Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The rattle seams can separate, exposing the fiber stuffing and bell rattle, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 14,400.

title: Kubota Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Injury and Collision Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The steering shaft can break and cause the operator to lose control of the vehicle, posing an injury hazard due to risk of collision. Units: About 23,400.

title: Robert Bosch Tool Recalls Grinders Due to Risk of Burns
summary: The grinder can overheat while in use, causing the brush covers to melt and expose the end of the brush holder, posing a risk of burns to the consumer. Units: About 91,000 (in addition, 18,000 were sold in Canada).

title: TwinGo Recalls Baby Carriers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The waist buckle can break, posing a fall hazard to children in the carrier. Units: About 4,000 (in addition, about 160 were sold in Canada).

title: American Honda Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The front door can open unexpectedly while the vehicle is in use, posing a risk of injury to occupants. Units: About 3,300.

title: Bednest Recalls Bedside Infant Sleepers Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The bedside sleepers fail to meet mandatory federal requirements for these products, posing a fall hazard to babies Units: About 500.

title: Cybex International Recalls Decline Free Weight Benches Due to Impact Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The frame on the bench can collapse forward onto the user, posing an impact injury hazard. Units: About 400.

title: BRP Recalls Side-by-Side Off-Road Vehicles Due to Loss of Steering Control and Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The steering coupling can strip on the rack and pinion assembly and result in a loss of steering control and crash hazard. Units: About 10,600.

title: Munchkin Recalls Latch Lightweight Pacifiers & Clips Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The clip cover can detach from the pacifier's clip, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 180,000.

title: Cascade Designs Recalls Avalanche Rescue Probes Due to Risk of Suffocation
summary: The lock button on the probe can fail to engage and lock, causing the probe not to function as intended. This can interfere with finding someone buried beneath snow, posing a suffocation hazard. Units: About 1,600 in the U.S. (in addition, about 230 were sold in Canada).

title: Walmart Recalls Rival Electric Water Kettles Due to Burn and Shock Hazards
summary: The heating element can fail and rupture, posing burn and shock hazards to the user. Units: About 1.2 million.

title: Tommee Tippee Sippee Spill-Proof Cups Recalled by Mayborn USA Due to Risk of Mold Exposure
summary: Mold can develop on the removable, one-piece, white valve inside the spill-proof Tommee Tippee Sippee cups when it remains wet/moist and is infrequently cleaned. The CPSC advises that mold ingestion poses a risk of gastrointestinal symptoms and infections in consumers with compromised immune systems

title: Box Components Recalls BMX Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The steer tube can become loose in the crown of the fork, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 4,100.

title: Currey & Company Recalls Chandeliers Due to Impact Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Ethan Allen (Recall Alert)
summary: The loop at the top of the chandelier can break causing the chandelier to fall, posing an impact injury hazard. Units: About 1,000 (in addition, 26 sold in Canada).

title: Hollander Sleep Products Recalls Mattress Pads Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively at Bed Bath & Beyond
summary: The mattress pads fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses and mattress pads, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4,700.

title: Osprey Recalls Child Backpack Carriers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A cut in the plastic buckle on the shoulder strap can cause the shoulder strap to release, posing a fall hazard to a child in the carrier. Units: About 31,000.

title: Rheem Recalls to Repair Water Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The control panel on the water heaters can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 54,000.

title: Hed Cycling Recalls Bicycle Rims Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The rims can cause the brake pads to wear out unexpectedly, posing a crash hazard to the rider. Units: About 380 units.

title: Honda Recalls Mini Tillers Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The throttle cable can be pinched during packaging, causing the tiller tines to rotate unexpectedly when the lever is not engaged, posing a risk of serious injury to consumers. Units: About 219,000 (in addition, about 7,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Noble House Recalls Counter Stools Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The kick plates of the counter stools can have a sharp edge, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,000.

title: TJX Recalls Foldable Lounge Chairs Due to Risk of Injury; Sold at T.J. Maxx and Marshalls Stores
summary: The chairs can collapse unexpectedly, posing a fall and injury hazard. Units: About 5,200.

title: Philips Lighting Recalls Metal Halide Lamps Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards
summary: The outer bulbs can shatter, resulting in hot internal pieces of glass falling from the lamps, posing a burn and laceration hazard. Units: About 87,000.

title: Rixson Exterior Gate Closers Recalled Due to Injury Hazard; Made by Assa Abloy Italia
summary: The gate closer mechanism can break and eject metal pieces including the spring or it can spray oil, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 130.

title: Water Heating Technologies Recalls Gas Water Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The water heaters have a space between the burner flange and the combustion chamber that allows flammable liquids or gases to contact burning flammable vapors inside the combustion chamber, posing a risk of fire or explosion. Units: About 14,400.

title: BESTAR Recalls Juvenile Dressers Due to Tip-over Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled dressers are unstable, posing a serious tip-over and entrapment hazard that can result in death or serious injuries to children. Units: About 26 (in addition, about 250 were sold in Canada).

title: Black Diamond Recalls Camming Climbing Devices Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The camming devices can come apart during use and fail, posing a fall hazard to the consumer. Units: About 45,500 (in addition, 5,700 units were sold in Canada).

title: Black Diamond Recalls Climbing Ascenders Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The Index Ascenders' rivet holding the toothed cam can release, allowing the Ascender to slide on the rope or become detached from the rope, posing a risk of injury or death to climbers from a fall. Units: About 2,800 (in addition, 300 were sold in Canada).

title: Black Diamond Recalls Via Ferrata Climbing Equipment Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Climbing sets sold without the orange safety stitching on the lanyards can allow the ends to unexpectedly detach, posing a risk of injury or death to climbers from a fall. Units: About 100.

title: Digital Clamp Meters Recalled by Klein Tools Due to Shock and Burn Hazards
summary: The meters can fail to give an accurate voltage reading, resulting in the operator falsely believing the electrical power is off, posing shock, electrocution and burn hazards. Units: About 114,000 (in addition, 3,300 were sold in Canada and 3,750 in Mexico).

title: Rocky Mountain Recalls Bicycles with Front Disc Brakes to Replace Quick Release Lever Due to Crash Hazard
summary: An open quick release lever on the bicycle's front wheel hub can come into contact with the front disc brake assembly, causing the front wheel to come to a sudden stop or separate from the bicycle, posing a risk of injury to the rider. Units: About 17,300 (in addition, 61,000 were sold in Canada).

title: SCOTT Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The seat post can break, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,400 (in addition, 170 bicycles were sold in Canada).

title: phil&teds Recalls Dash Strollers Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The hinge used to fold the dash v5 stroller can become damaged while opening and closing the stroller, posing a pinch hazard to the consumer. Units: About 630 in the U.S. (in addition, 240 were sold in Canada).

title: Pacific Cycle Recalls Infant Bicycle Helmets Due to Choking and Magnet Ingestion Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The magnetic buckle on the helmet's chin strap contains small plastic covers and magnets that can come loose, posing a risk of choking and magnet ingestion to young children. Units: About 129,000.

title: Target Recalls Menorahs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The menorahs can melt when the candles are burning. posing fire hazard. Units: About 2,600.

title: Broan-NuTone Recalls Ventilation Fans Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fan motor can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 450 in U.S. (in addition, 200 were sold in Canada).

title: Mirka Recalls Electric Random Orbital Sanders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The sanders can short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,500 (in addition about 300 were sold in Canada) (additional CEROS 550 and 650 sanders were recalled for a different fire hazard in January 2015).
